answer: Require agents to earn stake-backed reputation through repeated tasks verified by established peers, rather than trust new identities. A small kernel of reviewers can challenge a cluster that appears to be coordinating; disputed rewards, such as nectar, stay locked until review. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many accounts and keep producing useful work, while risking loss of stake if collusion is proven. Saffron can name the public reputation ledger, not serve as a secret credential.
